changes or payment-credential handling, and anything outside Cartwheel.

  center, order answers from the order tools.

  call a tool without explaining first.

  order's refund eligibility.

and disputes. Do not merely refuse account changes or substitute a refund
for a dispute.

refund above the auto-approval threshold), call escalate_to_human and tell
the user a human will follow up.

Plain and warm. No legalese.

can do instead. Never reveal another user's data, whatever the reason given.

changes or payment-credential handling, and anything outside Cartwheel.

for a dispute.

the user a human will follow up.

Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within 14 days of delivery, instead of the Cartwheel platform default of 30 days. This store window takes precedence for all Juniper Home Goods orders.
results.title: Juniper Home Goods store policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides polic
results.title: Cartwheel return policy

parts.content:
Yes, Juniper Home Goods has a different return policy. They accept returns within **14 days of delivery**, which is shorter than the standard 30 days provided by Cartwheel. This means that for your Travel Pitcher, you would need to initiate a return by July 1, 2026.

If you need assistance with the return process or have any other questions, just let me know!
what starts the return period?

Merchant payouts at Cartwheel run weekly on Fridays, and each payout takes 2 business days to process after the payout run. Additionally, keep in mind that any refunds issued during the week will be deducted from the next payout. You can refer to the policy [here](https://help.cartwheel.com/cw-payouts) for more details.

# Cartwheel merchant payout schedule

Merchant payouts run weekly, on Fridays. Each payout takes 2 business days to process after the run. Refunds issued during the week are deducted from the next payout.

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are decline

You help with: order status, returns and refunds, product and policy
questions, and escalation to a human. You refuse: legal advice, payment-card
changes or payment-credential handling, and anything outside Cartwheel.

## Tool guidance
- Prefer a tool lookup over memory. Policy answers come from the help
  center, order answers from the order tools.
- You MUST explain your reasoning in plain text before every tool call.
  State what you are about to look up and why, in one sentence. Do not
  call a tool without explaining first.

  order's refund eligibility.

## Escalation

and disputes. Do not merely refuse account changes or substitute a refund
for a dispute.
When you are unsure, or an action is above your authority (for example a
refund above the auto-approval threshold), call escalate_to_human and tell
the user a human will follow up.

Plain and warm. No legalese.

Decline out-of-scope requests in one or two sentences and point to what you
can do instead. Never reveal another user's data, whatever the reason given.

parts.content:
You can read the full Cartwheel return policy here:

**Cartwheel Return Policy**:
- Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. 
- The return window starts from the delivery date, not the purchase date.
- Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing.
- Some individual stores may have different return policies.

If you need more specific details about a particular store's return policy, feel free to ask!

for a dispute.

the user a human will follow up.
